t: Titan TTB1327SDR electric random orbit sander provides efficient material removal and smooth finishes on various surfaces, such as wood, metal, plastics and fillers. The lightweight, one-handed design is ideal for detailed finishing and larger surface prep, making it suitable for carpenters and decorators working on furniture restoration or preparation tasks. The corded tool features a 300W motor, soft-grip handle to enhance comfort, and a 6-speed variable control to match the speed to the material. Hook and loop paper fastening ensures quick sheet changes, while dust-sealed bearings offer extended tool life. Also equipped with dust extraction facility to help maintain a clean workspace. Supplied with a sanding sheet, dust bag and vacuum adaptor.
